item.title: MDC reports 301,954 deer harvested statewide in 2025-26 season
item.description: Missouri’s 2025-26 deer-hunting season ended Jan. 15, with the Missouri Department of Conservation reporting a preliminary statewide harvest of 301,954 deer. item.title: Senate committee moves Hawley rural hospital cybersecurity bill forward
item.description: U.S. Sen. Josh Hawley, R-Missouri, advanced his Rural Hospital Cybersecurity Enhancement Act during a markup by the Senate Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee.
